content.value_statement: Consistent pytest coverage is hard to start when source code changes quickly. This skill creates TDD-ready test boilerplate with fixtures, parametrization, type hints, and review steps.
actual_capabilities: Reads project documentation before generating tests.
Creates pytest boilerplate for functions, classes, async functions, and fixtures.
Uses AAA structure with type hints and docstrings.
Suggests happy path, edge case, error case, and parametrized tests.
Summarizes generated test files, test counts, and next steps.
References project commands for testing, coverage, and formatting.
limitations: Generated TODO sections need project-specific test data and assertions.
It depends on available source files and project documentation.
It does not verify that generated tests pass.
Unusual pytest plugins or project layouts may need manual edits.

use_cases.title: Add New Module Coverage
use_cases.description: Generate a first pytest file for a new Python module with basic, edge, and error cases.

use_cases.title: Start a TDD Task
use_cases.description: Create failing tests before implementation while following the project test structure.

use_cases.title: Standardize Test Fixtures
use_cases.description: Create fixture templates and shared setup patterns for consistent test suites.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Function Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single function.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate pytest tests for the validate_email function in src/python_modern_template/validators.py. Include valid input, invalid input, and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Create Class Test Boilerplate
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a class with several methods.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate tests for a UserManager class with create_user, delete_user, and find_user methods. Add a fixture for the class instance.

prompt_templates.title: Build Async Test Cases
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate pytest tests for async function fetch_data(url: str) -> dict. Include success, timeout, error response, and concurrent execution cases.

prompt_templates.title: Cover a Module with TDD Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for module-level planning and generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the project test conventions, inspect src/python_modern_template/validators.py, and generate a complete pytest boilerplate file with fixtures and parametrized cases.

output_examples.input: Generate tests for validate_email in the validators module.
output: Created a test file summary for validators.
Included valid email, invalid email, empty value, whitespace, and long value scenarios.
Listed TODO assertions and next steps for running the test suite.

output_examples.input: Generate tests for a UserManager class with three public methods.
output: Created a class-based pytest structure with an instance fixture.
Added test sections for initialization, each public method, and expected error cases.
Provided a concise summary of test classes, test functions, and follow-up edits.
Created async pytest cases for basic success and concurrent execution.
Suggested error scenarios for timeout and failed responses.
Marked areas where project-specific mock setup is required.

best_practices: Review every TODO and replace it with real test data.
Run generated tests before implementation to confirm the red phase.
Use parametrized tests for repeated input and expected output pairs.
anti_patterns: Do not accept placeholder assertions as final tests.
Do not over-mock internal functions that should be tested directly.
Do not generate tests without reading project conventions first.

faq.question: Does this skill write production code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on pytest boilerplate and test structure before implementation.

faq.question: Can it create parametrized tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a parametrized template for repeated input and expected output cases.

faq.question: Does it support async functions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pytest async examples with basic and concurrent execution cases.

faq.question: Will the generated tests pass immediately?
faq.answer: Not always. The skill expects users to replace TODO sections with real data and assertions.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include security-sensitive behavior?
faq.answer: The reviewed files contain templates and documentation only. No runtime command execution was found.
